text:
anya: gentle nudge — can someone take a look at PR #4526? console/observability change: adds a new dashboard metric (request_duration histograms) + automatic trace link on spans. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4526

matthew: can you paste the exact grafana query you'll use? want to check label/cardinality impact before we roll this into default dashboard.

anya: sure — using this for p50/p95:

```
SELECT histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)) by (route)
```

Also added `service_env` label to avoid cross-env mixing. Left a note in the PR about route cardinality.

kevin: quick skim — looks reasonable. two nits: 1) prefer `route_name` as label to be explicit, 2) in the trace link builder add a fallback so we don't NPE when trace_id is missing. tiny changes.

julia: CI is currently failing on `telemetry_integration_test::DashboardRender` — logs show "Timeout waiting for query response". Might be a flake from the test infra.

anya: i hit the same locally, bumping the timeout fixed it for me. i added a comment to the test to retry, but i don't think we should block merge on this single flake. we need 2 approvals per CODEOWNERS.

devx-bot: PR #4526 — checklist: CODEOWNERS review pending: @kevin, @julia. CI status: failing (1/5).

matthew: willing to approve if we either (a) mark the test as flaky/ignore for now, or (b) re-run CI and it's green. if this is urgent we can merge and follow up. :+1:

kevin: happy to re-run CI but i'm offline after 4pm PT. if this is blocking a rollout today, @matthew can merge after approval.

anya: aiming for EOD PT merge. if someone can approve now i can rebase and merge in the 4-5pm window. otherwise will wait till tomorrow morning.

matthew: leaving a review comment and approving pending CI green. :thumbsup:

devx-bot: CI re-run triggered for PR #4526 (run_id: 98765).

deploy-bot: CI re-run completed — all checks green except flaky integration test which passed on rerun.

julia: i left a small docs nit but approving once CI passes. good to go from my side.

anya: thanks — i'm going to merge after the green check. i'll watch the dashboards for 1 hour post-deploy and revert if anything spikes. tagging this as `observability-rollout` in the changelog. :eyes:

devx-bot: Merge executed by anya at 1802345895 for PR #4526 (merge_commit: a1b2c3d).
